newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha slips with crude, U.S interest remains.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha slips with crude, U.S interest remains.

text.p: European demand for naphtha was thinnish on Friday, but U.S interest remained steady.
"In theory it can go Stateside, but there is a problem of finding a ship, let alone the cost," said one trader.
Companies with own tonnage or time-charter vessels would be in a better position than those looking for spot tankers.
Prices were easier in line with weaker crude. A Dow spec cargo was sold by a trader at $236 cif NWE, to the same trader who bought a pipeline cargo at $238 yesterday.
Full range material was pegged around $232-234 cif NWE a tonne. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 8980
